Hi,

Thanks for sending the purchase details. I found your order, Shop····. Your NerdOctaxe was delivered on March 30, and I completely understand your position. A regulator failure on a unit that's less than eight months old is frustrating, and it makes sense that you'd think twice before spending more.

Please don't write the unit off yet. I'm not going to guess at the warranty terms for your unit. I've passed your case to the team who make warranty decisions, with the fault details and your order. They'll look at whether a return and replacement is possible for your unit. They'll also look at the compensation question you raised.

On the replacement board: we don't carry a populated NerdOctaxe PCB in the store right now. I've asked the team about that too.

The team is offline for the weekend. They'll pick this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and their answer will come to this email. Until then, please keep the unit unplugged.

As for the Magic M. 40T, there's no pressure from us. Let's get this one sorted first, and then you can decide on the 40T.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
